refnamediv.refpurpose: adjust the local UNIX clock, once

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: clockadd reads a TAI64NA time adjustment from standard input, as generated by a program such as taiclock1 or sntpclock1. It then adds that adjustment to the local UNIX clock.
refsection.note: clockadd must be run by the superuser.
refsection.para: The adjustment must be a single 16-byte packet, readable in a single call to read2. clockadd does not require that its standard input be a stream in blocking I/O mode.
The time is always "stepped" by calling settimeofday2. clockadd does not call adjtime2.

refsection.title: History
refsection.para: clockadd was originally part of Daniel J. Bernstein's clockspeed toolset in 1998.

refsection.title: Author
refsection.para: Original code and documentation by Daniel J. Bernstein. Documentation modernizations by Jonathan de Boyne Pollard.
